build_steps.command: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq build-essential gcc g++ make cmake bison flex gawk gperf libncurses5-dev gcc-arm-none-eabi git curl ninja-build && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

build_steps.description: Copy and execute repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace
Copy and execute setup_runtime.sh for runtime environment

runtime_mounts.description: Verifier assets mounted at runtime, not baked into image

notes: This container image contains the NuttX RTOS source code and build environment. The eval.sh verifier and tests are runtime-mounted, not baked into the image. The repo_setup.sh script clones the NuttX repository at a specific commit. The setup_runtime.sh script configures the build environment with nuttx-apps and Python dependencies.
